current_bottleneck: The current IV-only frontier has factor-linked failure geometry, but a pre-validation factor-score calibration policy does not transfer out of sample. Post-hoc factor calibration is not reliable enough; factor information needs to enter the learned core.
last_result_summary: 554a froze 510a/340c and sampled 192 pre-validation calibration plus 192 validation windows. Validation mean coverage90 was 0.859, upper stress miss rate 0.054, lower miss rate 0.087. Factor histories had material validation failure signal (levels_hist_mean vs coverage_under_target Spearman 0.534), but a chronological factor ridge score trained on calibration undercoverage had validation Spearman -0.108, while the IV-only ridge score was 0.146.
next_step_recommendation: Train a factor-conditioned core as a minimal extension of the 340c/392a empirical-normal-score path law, then evaluate whether learned factor conditioning repairs regime/stress under-inclusion without post-hoc factor policy knobs.
current_best_note: Both score 8/11 and fail coverage, regime_coverage, and distributional_fidelity. 510a improves coverage geometry and path KS but keeps level KS 10/25 and regime layer2 0/8 while thinning conditionality/cointegration margins.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
